 Latvia vs Armenia Preview & Prediction | 2026-27 UEFA Nations League | League C
 by Alex Lawes · 14 November 2026 at 11:17 am 
 Post 
 Share 
 Click here for today’s sports betting tips from our expert analysts! 
 Both of these teams have their places in Group 2 of the UEFA Nations League League C sewn up as Latvia welcome Armenia to Riga on Sunday. 
 Kick-off date/time: 
 15 November 2026 at 2:00 pm 
 How to watch on TV:  UK – Not televised / USA – FOX Sports
 How to watch online:  UK – Cannot be streamed / USA – FOX Sports streaming platforms
 Key stats 
 The final Group C2 placings for these two are already settled coming into Matchday 6: Armenia (five points) will finish third and Latvia (one point) fourth whatever happens, as Latvia can reach a maximum of four points.
 Armenia have won all three previous Nations League meetings with Latvia – 4-1 in Yerevan and 2-1 in Riga in 2024/25, then 2-0 in Yerevan on Matchday 1 of this edition – for an aggregate score of 8-2.
 Latvia are the only team in Group C2 without a win in this edition (W0 D1 L4); their one point came from a 0-0 home draw with Cyprus on 28 September.
 Latvia have lost their last three Nations League matches, all by a 2-1 scoreline (twice vs Montenegro and once vs Cyprus) – their longest losing run in 31 Nations League matches.
 Latvia's last Nations League win was a 1-0 home victory over Gibraltar in the 2024/25 play-offs on 31 March 2026, which completed a 2-0 aggregate success.
 Latvia have won four of their 15 Nations League home matches (D5 L6), scoring 11 goals and conceding 15.
 Armenia are winless in four Nations League matches (D2 L2) since beating Latvia 2-0 on Matchday 1, but are unbeaten in their last two after draws with Montenegro (0-0) and Cyprus (1-1).
 Armenia's last away win in the Nations League came in Riga, 2-1 vs Latvia on 17 November 2024; they are winless in their three away Nations League matches since (D1 L2).
 Armenia have conceded 55 goals in 31 Nations League matches (1.77 per game), while Latvia have conceded 34 in 31 (1.10 per game).
 Armenia topped Group C2 in 2020/21 with 11 points, their best Nations League league-phase tally across five editions.
 On Matchday 6 of the league phase, Latvia's Nations League record is W1 D2 L1 – including a 5-0 win in Andorra in 2020/21, their biggest win in 31 Nations League matches – while Armenia's is W2 D1 L1.
 Jānis Ikaunieks has scored seven goals in 19 Nations League appearances, level with Vladislavs Gutkovskis (seven in 25) as Latvia's joint-top scorer in the competition.
 Latvia vs Armenia prediction 
 Fortunate to be in a season without relegation ahead of a UEFA Nations League format shake up, Latvia have collected one point from five matches after avoiding League C relegation back in March with a promotion/relegation play-off defeat of Gibraltar.
 Armenia sit third in League C Group 2 with five points collected from their five matches. Their 1-1 draw against Cyprus the other day in Yerevan means that they cannot leapfrog the Southern Europeans in second place due to their head-to-head record.
 This is a low-quality contest but one that, with Latvia in particular, lack any sort of attacking quality or incision and so a low-scoring contest is to be expected for this one.
 Latvia vs Armenia tip:  Under 2.5 goals
